src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Montana Districting and Apportionment Commission, letter to the Secretary of State submitting the final congressional plan (Nov 12, 2021)

Montana regained a second seat; the Commission submitted its plan to the Secretary of State on Nov 12, 2021 (adopted at a Nov 9 meeting per news reports). First used Nov 2022. Census cb_2022 files hold the plans in effect for the 2022 election cycle, as submitted by the state's liaison (Census Redistricting Data Program pages).
